description: This file declares functions, classes, and constants for parsing and validating X.509 certificates and their extensions according to RFC 5280, including serial number verification, time parsing, and extension handling.

classes.name: ParsedTbsCertificate
classes.description: Contains parsed fields of a DER-encoded TBSCertificate as per RFC 5280.

classes.name: ParsedExtension
classes.description: Represents a parsed X.509 extension with its OID, value, and critical flag.

classes.name: ParsedBasicConstraints
classes.description: Holds the parsed data of the BasicConstraints extension.

classes.name: AuthorityInfoAccessDescription
classes.description: Describes an Authority Information Access extension entry with method OID and location.

classes.name: ParsedDistributionPoint
classes.description: Represents a parsed DistributionPoint for CRL distribution points.

classes.name: ParsedAuthorityKeyIdentifier
classes.description: Holds parsed data of the AuthorityKeyIdentifier extension.

methods.name: VerifySerialNumber
methods.description: Verifies if a serial number is a valid DER-encoded INTEGER up to 20 octets, allowing non-positive values.

methods.name: ReadUTCOrGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Reads a Time value (UTC or Generalized) from a DER parser.

methods.name: ParseValidity
methods.description: Parses the validity period of a certificate, extracting notBefore and notAfter times.

methods.name: ParseCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded X.509 certificate, extracting its main components.

methods.name: ParseTbsCertificate
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertificate part of an X.509 certificate, with options for validation.

methods.name: ParseExtension
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded extension into its components.

methods.name: ParseExtensions
methods.description: Parses a sequence of extensions into a map keyed by OID.

methods.name: ConsumeExtension
methods.description: Removes and retrieves a specific extension by OID from a set of extensions.

methods.name: ParseBasicConstraints
methods.description: Parses the BasicConstraints extension, indicating CA status and path length.

methods.name: ParseKeyUsage
methods.description: Parses the KeyUsage extension, validating the key usage bits.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccess
methods.description: Parses the Authority Information Access extension, extracting method and location info.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccessURIs
methods.description: Extracts CA Issuers and OCSP URIs from AuthorityInfoAccess extension.

methods.name: ParseCrlDistributionPoints
methods.description: Parses CRL Distribution Points extension into distribution points.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Parses the AuthorityKeyIdentifier extension, extracting key ID, issuer, and serial number.

methods.name: ParseSubjectKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Parses the SubjectKeyIdentifier extension, extracting the key identifier.
